title: AI in Healthcare: Opportunities and Challenges
summary: Artificial intelligence has the potential to improve healthcare by providing tools for independent living, virtual assessments, and smart home devices. However, there are also concerns about bias, accountability, and ethics in AI development. The use of AI in healthcare can bring numerous benefits, including improved mood, reduced anxiety, and increased freedom from family moderation.
